en: The front of the postcard shows a black-and-white photograph of a traditional German house with timber framing set against a backdrop of dense forest and open fields. The text at the bottom reads 'Bad Pyrmont' and 'Ausflugsort Erdfälle'. The reverse side of the postcard includes German text indicating that it is a postcard from the 'Ausflugsort Gasthaus zu den Erdfällen' in Bad Pyrmont, with reference to a local pension run by W. Terhardt. There is also a stamp from the 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont'.
